title: Home in the Nations, 6 Mins to Broadway
description:
Get ready for the ultimate Music City experience at our spacious, stylish home in the trendy Nations neighborhood. Perfect for large groups, bachelor/bachelorette parties, or family getaways, you're only a short 6-minute drive (or quick ride) from the iconic honky-tonks of Broadway. 
Walk to local bars in The Nations! Enjoy your private deck and backyard, perfect for morning coffee or drinks under the stars with A TV.
Features a chef's kitchen, large living/dining areas with TV's in every room.

The space
One of the biggest lots in the nations neighborhood. A 2-story, 4 bed, 3.5 bath that can host up to 14 people comfortably. Outdoor TV on side porch. Also has a sizable fenced in yard that includes a detached garage that connect to back alley.

Guest access
The whole house is yours!
